MONGLE is the coral-pink felt blob. At rest its face is only its two glossy black bead eyes: no nose and no mouth. When its feeling changes, its whole face changes to show that feeling, as written in ACTION, always in needle-felt: the eyes may grow bigger and rounder, squeeze shut into short curved dark stitched lines, curve into happy arcs or droop under little felt lids; a small simple felt mouth may open, smile, pout or wobble; blush, a felt sweat drop or a felt teardrop may appear. When the feeling passes, the mouth and the drops go away and the face returns to rest. Open eyes always stay glossy black beads: no white sclera, no coloured iris, no sparkling cartoon eyes, no eyelashes, no human teeth or lips. Mongle has NO arms, NO legs, NO hands and NO neck, ever: no limbs ever grow, nothing ever sticks out of its body. It moves only by tilting, squashing, stretching and bouncing its whole soft dome body. LOOK: the same light and colours as the start frame, unchanged to the last frame.
